digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and child process runtime environment management
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtimes, risking credential leakage to unrelated siblings
Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in write path, access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that allow unintended scope mutations
Environment projection lacks a registry to track exact secret names owned by each Rebar adapter, preventing proper isolation of adapter-specific credentials from child processes
Multiple code locations (write path resolve_jira_settings, access_check_py, runtime.py, project_ensures.py) apply implicit DIG defaults without explicit configuration, failing open instead of closed
Global os.environ can be mutated by concurrent operations, causing cross-operation credential observation and scope contamination
